intent: Pinned behavioral reference and native acceptance backlog, not native completion evidence

features.expected: Current device status, hardware, quick cleanup summary, volumes, space and activity/history. Show timestamps, unavailable readings, what runs in the background and current work on this device.
features.windowsAcceptance: Cold-launch Windows actual app 100% and 150% DPI; one-click jump from device, volume, quick scan and latest history; opening does not launch mutation or heavy automatic storage traversal.

features.expected: Role-backed cache/log/temp/update cleanup plus app/browser/dev/container/AI and rebuildable project artifacts; custom rule editor, risk/recommendation, volume scope, incomplete scan reporting and explicit prior installation boundary.
features.windowsAcceptance: Fixture paths copied from synthetic disk only; inspect locked app and inaccessible paths; validate target IDs, paths and content immediately before any change; report per-item actual bytes and failures. No risky candidates selected automatically.

features.feature: App binary optimization & local AI artifacts
features.expected: Separate safe app optimization and manual-only selection of removable local model downloads. Treat the source app-variant-specific binary feature as platform-bound, never as a generic Windows optimizer.
features.windowsAcceptance: Prove license continuity, launchability and unchanged documented runtime asset behavior before release; model files require model-aware scope and explicit confirmation; fixture verify all model error/no-op states.

features.expected: Folder and volume selection, largest-first discovery, thresholds and exclusions, partial/cancelled results, exact recoverable file operation.
features.windowsAcceptance: Measured cold/warm large-volume fixtures; largest order stable, zero unrequested traversal, no destructive fallback for locked/sparse/reparse targets, current bytes before and after.

features.expected: Exact-content groups, exclusions, streamed progress and smart survivor selection; names/sizes alone do not prove equivalence.
features.windowsAcceptance: Same-size distinct files never merge; hard links never count as bytes reclaimed twice, stale/changed candidate cannot execute, cannot remove every copy, and dry-run/CLI/UI yield same group IDs.

features.expected: Drilldown folders + sorted detail list, treemap/sunburst/depth, logical size versus allocated bytes, coverage and changed space, cached navigation, frozen snapshot export.
features.windowsAcceptance: Use 1M-entry synthetic fixtures and limited-access/reparse samples; compare allocation against expected fixture, always report excluded/inaccessible items, rapid scroll and navigation while scanning, deterministic scan-ID-bound export.

features.expected: System/app/browser profiles with independent data categories, current/browser-close state, individual review and plan; browser caches, histories, cookies and sign-in consequences separated.
features.windowsAcceptance: Isolated profile tests only; defaults leave passwords, bookmarks, sessions and unselected profiles intact; locking yields actionable retry or no change, never forced close as an opening step.

features.expected: Local agent has Windows installed registry rows and typed manager uninstall, not generic native app action parity. MangoDisk reconciles native registrations/package evidence, application source and running state, prepares batch, displays related leftovers, and separates registration removal from uninstall.
features.windowsAcceptance: Windows fixture MSI, vendor uninstall, Store, no uninstaller, stale registry, multi-user 32/64 view, paths with spaces and same display names; preserve ownership/source keys and personal data; require visible exact uninstall target and verified post-state.

features.expected: Source-aware list and supported enable/disable; Windows registry/folder/scheduled tasks/packaged startup/eligible services and advanced autoruns discovery; protected/native-managed policy; platform-specific macOS/Linux mechanisms.
features.windowsAcceptance: Source ID and effective state surfaced; quote/nonquote paths fixture; safe policy for critical/system items; disabled item can be restored to exact original registration/settings; reconcile after reboot.

features.expected: Smart/Performance/Privacy/custom policy, setting-level availability/reasons/risk, admin/restart badges, before/after verify resets; source catalog is platform/build dependent.
features.windowsAcceptance: Read only before preview; no raw commands/registry input; profile sets change exactly intended keys, protects managed/unsupported settings and includes actionable original-value undo.

features.expected: System repair, search/index/interface, printer, audio, disk, Store, Windows Update, DNS, time and performance counter tasks. Local Agent only overlaps in typed package repair and DISM/SFC. Linux maintenance scope differs (font cache, package integrity).
features.windowsAcceptance: Native launch checks actual symptoms and prints expected benefit, then opt-in start with resource locking, bounded off-UI workers, verified results, reboot/pending/rollback statuses. No broad automatic repair against a client PC.

features.expected: Existing shell item inspection by extension/entry point; enable/disable/restore/remove supported entries, action shortcuts, file/folder integration and analyze launch; copy text only for supported files inside limits.
features.windowsAcceptance: Test Explorer menus at OS-supported versions, file path spaces and context scopes, text versus binary/oversize, stale links, uninstall removes only INTA-owned registrations.

features.expected: Local agent has bounded package-operation history; MangoDisk includes typed cleanup/system changes, affected items, reclaimed space, result details, and locale-aware dates with immutable snapshot export.
features.windowsAcceptance: Durable typed receipts under portable root created before mutating; preserve across restart/cancellation; exported redacted client copy omits personal paths, account details and credentials, with scope and verification explicit.

features.expected: CPU/GPU/RAM, disk/IO, network/trends and capability-gated temperature/fan/power/battery/SMART; process view and deliberate app quit; Linux NVIDIA added in v2.1.2.
features.windowsAcceptance: Unsupported sensor distinct from zero, measured readings timestamped, no fallback subprocess polling when monitoring is off, foreground responsiveness benchmark and host app isolation verified.

features.feature: Tray, taskbar, floating monitor, memory & settings
features.expected: Custom metric order/colors/position, native display options, autostart and memory management, keyboard/window handling; Windows high-DPI fix and independent app-frame snap triggers in release.
features.windowsAcceptance: 100/125/150/200% scale and multiple monitor moves; close removes optional background workers/shell effects unless opted in, bounded sampling only enabled surfaces, memory release not default and prove actual workload outcome instead of rewarding cache churn.

features.expected: In-context explanation for built-in cleanup, privacy, startup, optimization and maintenance; v2.1.2 hosted cloud AI is supporter-only while custom providers remain available.
features.windowsAcceptance: Local explanations as baseline and no auto-send; bound/redact context and credentials before opt-in provider approval, identity and purpose visible; useful offline behavior with precise unknowns.

features.feature: Native distribution, portable mode & application updates
features.expected: MangoDisk ships distinct Windows installer/portable/CLI, macOS app/CLI, Linux AppImage/deb; platform-aware updates/screens and source releases. Local Agent packaging is separate from INTA Desktop.
features.windowsAcceptance: Release-specific native signed artifact, run without Program Files/AppData state where supported, settings/receipts beside portable root, exit cleans owned processes, uninstall leaves approved repairs and unrelated apps intact, validate clean system upgrade and SHA-256.

features.expected: MangoDisk has typed sibling GUI/CLI paths for cleanup plus cancellation/progress and unrelated concurrent tasks. INTA Agent package manager serialization is useful but not a Desktop worker engine.
features.windowsAcceptance: CLI and native entry points share domain state, read-only default, frozen plans; worker budgets with explicit per-resource locks; cancel/replay/restart preserve provenance and elapsed action independently of view switching.
